name: Comfortably Numb
description: You are given an array $$$a$$$ consisting of $$$n$$$ non-negative integers. The numbness of a subarray $$$a_l, a_{l+1}, \ldots, a_r$$$ (for arbitrary $$$l \leq r$$$) is defined as $$$$$$\max(a_l, a_{l+1}, \ldots, a_r) \oplus (a_l \oplus a_{l+1} \oplus \ldots \oplus a_r),$$$$$$ where $$$\oplus$$$ denotes the bitwise XOR operation . Find the maximum numbness over all subarrays.
input_specification: Each test contains multiple test cases. The first line contains the number of test cases $$$t$$$ ($$$1 \le t \le 1000$$$). The description of the test cases follows. The first line of each test case contains a single integer $$$n$$$ ($$$1 \leq n \leq 2 \cdot 10^5$$$). The second line of each test case contains $$$n$$$ integers $$$a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n$$$ ($$$0 \leq a_i \leq 10^9$$$). It is guaranteed that the sum of $$$n$$$ over all test cases does not exceed $$$2 \cdot 10^5$$$.
output_specification: For each test case, print one integer — the maximum numbness over all subarrays of the given array.
approach_summary: Build a Segment Tree over the array. Implement point update and associative range query operations in O(log N) time per query.
